title: Diagrams & Architecture
tagline: Synthesize clear Mermaid diagrams, sequence flows, C4 models, and topology maps

cases.title: Sidecar Process Supervision Sequence Diagram
cases.description: Visualize Tauri Rust supervisor, SHA-256 pre-check, and Python FastAPI heartbeat handshake.
cases.prompt: Generate a Mermaid sequence diagram showing Tauri Rust shell spawning the Python sidecar, polling /healthz, and graceful SIGTERM shutdown.
cases.sample_output:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant T as Tauri Rust Shell
  participant S as Python Sidecar
  T->>S: Spawn child process (binaries/agent-engine-sidecar)
  loop Health Check
    T->>S: GET /healthz
    S-->>T: 200 OK (status: live)
  end
  T->>S: SIGTERM on app close
  S-->>T: Exit 0 (graceful cleanup)
```

cases.title: C4 Container Architecture Map
cases.description: Document system boundaries, desktop frontend, local sidecar, and external model provider APIs.
cases.prompt: Create a C4 container diagram in Mermaid detailing the Agent Engine desktop client, local databases, and external LLM endpoints.
cases.sample_output:
```mermaid
graph TD
  User((User)) -->|Interacts| UI[Tauri Desktop App]
  UI -->|Local HTTP/SSE| API[FastAPI Sidecar]
  API -->|Read/Write| DB[(SQLite / ChromaDB)]
  API -->|Outbound HTTPS| LLM[Frontier Providers]
```
